description: This Java class provides helper methods for managing order status changes, including approval, rejection, completion, and cancellation of orders, as well as related operations like inventory reservation management and invoice creation within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OrderChangeHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle order status transitions and related operations in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: approveOrder
methods.description: Approves an order, updating its status and related item statuses, with optional hold status.

methods.name: rejectOrder
methods.description: Rejects an order, updating its status, canceling inventory reservations, and releasing payment authorizations.

methods.name: completeOrder
methods.description: Marks an order as completed, creating received payments and invoice.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.description: Cancels an order, updating status, canceling inventory reservations, and releasing payments.

methods.name: orderStatusChanges
methods.description: Updates the order header, item, and digital item statuses, handling errors.

methods.name: cancelInventoryReservations
methods.description: Cancels inventory reservations for an order.

methods.name: releasePaymentAuthorizations
methods.description: Releases payment holds for an order.

methods.name: createReceivedPayments
methods.description: Creates payment records for an order based on payment preferences.

methods.name: createOrderInvoice
methods.description: Generates an invoice for the order.
